description: Presidential Secretariat - Declaration of the Services Connected to the Supply of Electricity to be an Essential Public Service.
reasoning: This gazette content involves the President issuing an order under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979 to declare electricity supply services as essential public services. This constitutes a regulatory action and legal declaration under existing legislation, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than focusing on government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
